senses.gloss: f. (כשר; cmp. גִּשְׁרָא) joist, beam, post.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 19:8">Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 8</cite> (O. <cite ref="U01991"><he>שָׁרִיתָא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="S02020"><he>קֹרָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 6:2">Targ. II Kings VI, 2</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>שדי</he>, Var. <cite ref="U01959"><he>שרי</he></cite>, <he>כ׳</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Horayot 3b:10">Hor. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>כי היכי דנימטין שיבא מכ׳</he> in order that each of us may carry off a chip of the beam (that you may share the responsibility with me).
<cite ref="Ketubot 17a:7">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אין דמיין עלייכי ככ׳</he> if they (the brides you carry in procession) are on your shoulders like a beam (awaking no sensual desire).
Ib. 86ᵇ; B. Kam. 98ᵇ כי כ׳ לצלמי like a beam fit for decorative mouldings (proverbial expression for straight and exact), v. גְּבִי.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:13">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite> … <he>מיחברי כ׳ וכ׳</he> ten persons combine to steal a beam and are not ashamed of one another; a. e.—Pl. <he>כְּשׁוֹרִין</he>, <he>כְּשׁוֹרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 34:11">Targ. II Chr. XXXIV, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:17">Targ. Cant. I, 17</cite> <he>כְּשׁוֹרוֹהִי</he> (some ed. <he>כָּשְׁרוֹהִי</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ ציבי מז׳ כ׳</he> seven chips from seven beams.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a:9">B. Kam. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>גובי ועבדינהו כ׳</he> if one stole trunks and made them into joists (by trimming).
Gitt. 67ᵇ איעסק בכ׳ busied himself with carrying (or trimming) beams; a. e.—Trnsf. lengthy slices of a radish.

<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:7">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>במערבא מלחי כ׳ כ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כִּישְׁרֵי</he>, Ar. <he>כִּשְׁרֵי</he>, Var. <he>כִּישֵׁי</he>; Alf. <he>פישרי</he>) in Palestine they salt them (on the Sabbath) each slice by itself (just as they are eaten).
